title: Fleet, spares and crash cases, Italian and English
goal: A model's fleet, spares and crash tool use is measured
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ok to all" (accepts proposals 1 to 3 of the shared-asset review, solution:F-016-T05); same message: "nerv and all modules will need to work with Italian".

Cases (when F-011 registers its tools) cover drone detail, spares by category, a crash log and spares in and out, Italian first: "ho crashato Smoke, motore sinistro inferiore rotto … quanti ne sono rimasti di scorta (nuovi/usati)?"; a spare count changes only when the phrase says a spare was used; English equivalents
The pack is tagged so NERV can run it (nerv:F-120-T11)
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: About 10 to 14 cases, half Italian. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the solution:F-016 shared-asset review. Not a measurement.
